info.name: Flipturn Access IDs Charging Sessions API

params.name: startTimeAfter
params.description: ISO 8601: only sessions started at or after this time.

params.name: startTimeBefore
params.description: ISO 8601: only sessions started before this time.

params.name: endTimeAfter
params.description: ISO 8601: only sessions ended at or after this time.

params.name: endTimeBefore
params.description: ISO 8601: only sessions ended before this time.

params.name: includeIntervals
params.description: Include per-15-minute interval statistics and max demand. Limits the key to 1 concurrent request.

params.name: includeTouEnergy
params.description: Include energy usage grouped into time-of-use periods.

params.name: includeInProgressSessions
params.description: Include charging sessions that are in progress.

params.name: siteIds
params.description: Filter by site IDs, e.g. siteIds[]=101&siteIds[]=102.

params.name: nextPageCursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextPageCursor to fetch the next page. Keep all other parameters identical.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of charging sessions, filterable by start/end time, site, charger, and customer. Optional includes add per-interval statistics, time-of-use energy, and in-progress sessions. Results are paginated with an opaque cursor.
